programme.title: Mercenary for Justice
programme.desc: Widowed when his FBI agent wife is killed by an extremist group, college professor Michael Faraday (Jeff Bridges) becomes obsessed with the culture of these groups -- especially when his new all-American neighbors, Oliver (Tim Robbins) and Cheryl Lang (Joan Cusack), start acting suspiciously. With each twist, the mystery deepens and questions loom whether Faraday is consumed by fear and driven by paranoia, or whether a lethal conspiracy has been born on Arlington Road.

programme.title: 24 Hours To D-Day
programme.desc: In a hijacked seabase thousands of feet below the ocean's surface, terrorist Lars Rynark threatens to release a dangerous biotoxin that will destroy the entire undersea ecosystem. programme.title: Mercenary for Justice
programme.desc: Widowed when his FBI agent wife is killed by an extremist group, college professor Michael Faraday (Jeff Bridges) becomes obsessed with the culture of these groups -- especially when his new all-American neighbors, Oliver (Tim Robbins) and Cheryl Lang (Joan Cusack), start acting suspiciously. With each twist, the mystery deepens and questions loom whether Faraday is consumed by fear and driven by paranoia, or whether a lethal conspiracy has been born on Arlington Road.

programme.title: Good Fences [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Following a traumatic experience, former Special Forces member Dean Cage (Wesley Snipes) is trying to pick up the pieces of his fractured life. With the help of detective Amy Knight (Jacqueline Obradors), Dean tries to block out the painful wartime memories, including the death of his best friend. Everything goes awry, however, when Dean is mistaken for a rogue CIA agent. He is abducted and given a truth serum, and now he must find an antidote to the debilitating psychotropic drug.

programme.title: American Violet
programme.desc: Set in Los Angeles, this series follows Jamiel Chambers, a blue chip high-schooler on the brink of escaping the desperate poverty that has berated inner city America. After his junior year ends with him leading his team to a second place finish in the state's regional tournament, Jamiel is hand-picked to play in the city's annual summer league All-Star game. With college recruits swarming and pro agents hedging, the media circus leans in, peddling the question mark around his future like rabid bookies. It is this exposure that gets the attention of Nick Collins, a derelict from a disreputable family from neighboring Irvine. After his doomed-from-the-start plan to capitalize on Jamiel's notoriety ends in with fatal results, family members from both sides are pulled into a series of events which will not only effect Jamiel's trajectory, but will set up one of the most intense family feuds the city has ever witnessed.

After his junior year ends with him leading his team to a second place finish in the state's regional tournament, Jamiel is hand-picked to play in the city's annual summer league All-Star game. With college recruits swarming and pro agents hedging, the media circus leans in, peddling the question mark around his future like rabid bookies. It is this exposure that gets the attention of Nick Collins, a derelict from a disreputable family from neighboring Irvine. After his doomed-from-the-start plan to capitalize on Jamiel's notoriety ends in with fatal results, family members from both sides are pulled into a series of events which will not only effect Jamiel's trajectory, but will set up one of the most intense family feuds the city has ever witnessed.

programme.title: Tuesday Night Pickleball
programme.desc: Experience the high-stakes drama of the 2023 DUPR Collegiate National Championship Finals as the University of Virginia (UVA) battles the defending champions from the University of North Carolina (UNC). This pivotal mixed doubles showdown is defined by "Racing" energy and relentless scoreboard pressure, with teams trading blows through intense scoring stretches like 13-7 and 19-12. The elite "Skills" of these collegiate athletes are on full display as they navigate the complexities of rally scoring, eventually reaching a critical 20-13 milestone that underscores UVA's gritty push to force a historic Dreambreaker. Captured in the heat of the moment, this match showcases the "Freestyle" tenacity and tactical brilliance required to compete for the biggest prize in collegiate pickleball.

This pivotal mixed doubles showdown is defined by "Racing" energy and relentless scoreboard pressure, with teams trading blows through intense scoring stretches like 13-7 and 19-12. The elite "Skills" of these collegiate athletes are on full display as they navigate the complexities of rally scoring, eventually reaching a critical 20-13 milestone that underscores UVA's gritty push to force a historic Dreambreaker. Captured in the heat of the moment, this match showcases the "Freestyle" tenacity and tactical brilliance required to compete for the biggest prize in collegiate pickleball.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: From the BerryWorks to Strawberry's Café, everyone is excited about who will win this year's Spring Flower Festival! Berry Bitty City is decorated with colorful banners proclaiming the big event. Lemon works the hardest. For weeks she has watered her violets by day and sung to them at night, doing everything she can to win first prize. With the contest just a day away, Lemon is at her garden early.
